title: SiteTunerCalcStatsStart
description: Start calculation of SiteTuner statistics for the given time interval using the current set of parameters

requestId.description: The user must allocate a unique identifier for the request. Needed to handle multiple users accessing the SiteTuner interface simultaneously. This id will be present in the result

from.description: The suppressionCount statistics in the SiteTunerCalcStatsResult response will be collected this far back in time. Setting a large interval may cause a slow reply.

to.description: The suppressionCount statistics in the SiteTunerCalcStatsResult response will be collected up to this time.

force.description: If set, any ongoing stats calculation will be forced to stop and the new calculation will start. Default: false
